title: READ THAT AGAIN. 🗣️
paragraphs: The loudest statement you ever make about your own character is how you speak about others when they aren't in the room to defend themselves.
Are you using your words as armor to protect, or as daggers to destroy from the shadows? A true Gospel Warrior doesn’t stab their brother in the back; they stand back-to-back with them in the battle.
Integrity is who you are when nobody is looking.
⚔️ "Let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths, but only such as is good for building up, as fits the occasion, that it may give grace to those who hear." — Ephesians 4:29
Does this hit home? Drop a 🔥 if you are committing to speaking life.
